svg.aria-label: Ten second timeline: one frame per second is sampled; the door opens between seconds 4 and 5
svg.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Sampled frames (1 fps): 10 of the 300 frames reach the model
The model sees the before and after, never the action. Who opened it, and how, is gone.
